# Dishcuss

> > Dishcuss is a visual search engine for discovering and exploring images and photos across diverse topics and subjects.

Dishcuss provides an image-centric search experience, allowing users to find visual content spanning cultural landmarks, historical figures, geographical locations, and various subjects. The platform serves as a comprehensive image database for visual discovery and exploration.

## Key Topics

- visual-search
- image-search
- photo-discovery
- image-database
- search-engine
- Charlie Chaplin

- Mexico
- Durga

- historical figures
- geographical locations
